description: May 28 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 28 birthday falls in Gemini, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: May 28 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Twenty-eight reduces to 1, and May 28th brings that independent number into early Gemini, about six degrees along. Mercury's first decan sharpens the mind; the 1 points it towards leadership. This birthday is traditionally associated with original thinking and a preference for setting the agenda. The usual caution is to finish one project before the next idea arrives.

On May 28 the Sun usually sits at about 6° Gemini, in the first decan, where Mercury rules the decan as well as the sign. Doubled Mercury makes the first ten degrees of Gemini, roughly May 21 to May 31, the most quicksilver part of an already lively sign. Curiosity is the engine here: questions, conversations, books opened at the middle, two projects running at once. Traditional descriptions stress wit, verbal agility and a talent for translating between people who would not otherwise understand each other. The same speed can make boredom arrive early and commitments feel like cages. For anyone born in this decan, depth often comes not from slowing down overall but from choosing one or two threads to follow all the way through.

sections.heading: May 28 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 28th reduces as 2 + 8 = 10, then 1 + 0 = 1. The birthday number is 1, but reached by a route that runs through partnership (2) and authority (8). Numerologists often read the 28th as a more cooperative kind of leader than the 1st: independent and ambitious, yet aware that big plans need allies. Those born on this day are frequently described as determined, enterprising and persuasive. As a supporting number, the 28 tends to show in a talent for starting things with others already on board, rather than recruiting help after the fact.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 28 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on May 28: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 28 is the 148th day of the year (149th in a leap year). By June 22, 25 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Cancer.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 28, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 28 include Kylie Minogue (1968), Patrick White (1912) and Marco Rubio (1971).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 28?
faq.answer: May 28 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 28?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 28 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 28th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 28?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 28 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 28?
faq.answer: May 28 is also the birthday of Kylie Minogue (1968), Patrick White (1912) and Marco Rubio (1971). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
